D/ [FL IVL HE]LENAE AVG ; R/ [P]AX PVBLICA

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Helena, dating to AD 337-40 (Reece Period 17), PAX PVBLICA, Pas standing left holding branch and sceptre. Mint of Trier. Obverse description: Draped bust right. Obverse inscription: [FL IVL HE]LENAE AVG. Reverse description: Pax standing left, holding branch and sceptre. Reverse inscription: [P]AX PVBLICA. Reverse mint mark: - // TRP.
